Queensboro Bridge bagels and lox.d: Toasted bagels, cream cheese, sliced Nova, capers, red onion cut thin and fresh dill.
Queensboro Bridge bagels and lox.note: Wrapped to go for the bench by the bridge.

Elaine's crostini.d: Little rounds of French bread, toasted. Ricotta with lemon peel and honey, or mushrooms, garlic and thyme under Parmesan.
Elaine's crostini.note: From the bar, from six o'clock.

Chinese takeaway in bed.d: Diced dark meat stir-fried hot with dried red peppers, soy, rice wine and black vinegar. Roasted peanuts, scallions and rice.
Chinese takeaway in bed.note: Szechuan style. Packed to go for the late movie.

Worth-living-for cheesecake.d: Lemon and vanilla on a buttery crumb crust. Baked slow, chilled overnight.
Worth-living-for cheesecake.note: Worth living for, the regulars say.

Manhattan cocktail.d: Rye, sweet vermouth and bitters, stirred cold, served up with a cherry.
